sources_read: .qc-cache/hireops-lessons-2026-10-08-r1/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx (Quality Checks row 22 = check 21; Internal Quality Checks row 22; Deterministic Checks check-verifier-contract.py, check-scoring-policy.py; read via zipfile in memory)
evidence:
Frozen tests/test.sh (sha256 bd682592...abe5aa) is byte-identical to the frozen template rules/projects/webdev-task-template/tests/test.sh (diff empty; same hash); tests/tools/score.py, tools/restart_mcp.py, scoring.toml and tests/Dockerfile also diff-identical to template. Walked every path against workbook Quality Checks D22 / Internal Quality Checks D22 (no annotations on row 22), skill references/quality-checks.md #21 and staged-task-contract.md 'tests/test.sh' ordered contract:
(1) write_zero_reward (test.sh:14-18, called at :60) writes reward.txt 0.0, full ZERO_REWARD_JSON (reward, five dimensions, gates_passed, floors_passed, weighted_score, graded, no_op) and ctrf before any grading; trap cleanup EXIT (:61) kills the app process group and calls ensure_reward (:20-23); no exec anywhere. Because the zero is pre-written, even SIGKILL/verifier-timeout termination leaves a reward. Only :10-12 (mkdir/chmod of LOG_DIR) precede it, which cannot write a reward if they fail anyway.
(2) Early exits all exit 0 after the zero: missing REWARDKIT_JUDGE/MODEL (:63-66; task.toml [verifier.env] sets both), missing /app/server.js (:68-70), any symlink outside /app/node_modules or escaping it (:72-83), app not answering within 120x0.25s (:115-125).
(3) Safe launch: /app copied to /tmp/submission, setsid env -i with only PATH, NODE_PATH, HOME, PORT=3000, DB_PATH, setpriv --reuid/regid 65534 --clear-groups (:90-112); liveness via probe_ready on /api/health then / (:42-58) before RewardKit.
(4) Restart helper generated by heredoc+sed, chmod 755, APP_RESTART_HELPER exported (:127-193); {app_context} substituted into all five prompts (each contains exactly one {app_context}).
(5) gates suite (budget 1500) then score.py: rc0 continue, rc1 keep detailed gate-fail record (reward 0), other -> write_zero_reward (:212-222); stale scored dir removed first (:212) so gate-stage score.py sees scored_data=None and yields reward 0.0; gate suite timeout/failure -> exit 0 with pre-written zero. scored suite (11100) then score.py || write_zero_reward (:224-227); scored timeout leaves gate-stage record with reward 0.0. score.py:86-91 converts every exception to rc2.
Budgets nest: gates judges 600+600=1200<1500; scored 9000+900+900=10800<11100 (max-concurrent-agent 1); 1500+11100=12600 < [verifier] timeout_sec 13200.
Task-side agreement: instruction.md:15 and environment/instructions/integration.md state /app/server.js, port 3000, GET /api/health, DB_PATH, and integration.md:16-19 discloses the symlink restriction, so the refusal path is not a hidden trap. Golden solve.sh copies solution/app (server.js present, no symlinks); bootstrap.js:43 listens on PORT before SQLite init and runs the app in a Worker thread (same process group, killed by kill -- -PGID); db.js:9,19 honours DB_PATH.
Adversarial: a broken app that returns HTTP 500 everywhere passes liveness (HTTPError counts as ready) but cannot pass the browser gates -> reward 0 via score.py rc1; a dead static shell likewise. A conforming alternative that symlinks e.g. /app/public/lib -> /app/src would score 0, but integration.md forbids that explicitly. An app forking a detached daemon (new session) could survive cleanup, but that cannot change the reward.
Lessons file (handoffs/LESSONS_FROM_COLDERWATER_2026-10-08.md) checked for row-relevant patterns: #4 gates kept simple (gate criteria are load/sign-in and one server-backed add+independent readback; not this row's defect); #11 judge infra crash in a gate zeroes the whole reward through score.py rc1/rc2 by template design - honest zero, not a missing reward; #19 the scripted golden harness (qc/repairs/hireops-2026-10-03-workspace/workspace.cjs:16, hash ec0c118d verified) spawns node /app/server.js with a sanitized env but NOT through test.sh/setpriv/the /tmp/submission copy, so it does not exercise this entrypoint.
Risk: raw-evidence-index.json (entries' hashes verified for workspace.cjs, workspace.json, server.js, solve.sh) itself states full configured grading/verifier launch is absent. No execution of this test.sh on the current candidate (launch, liveness, both suites, reward files) exists, so the always-scores behaviour is source-verified only. Not a defect; a required measurement gap for the full-verifier-launch record.
